<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_snc_duty_travel.HKOWeatherHandler</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Implements extension point x_snc_duty_travel.HKOWeatherHandler</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>HKOWeatherHandler</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var HKOWeatherHandler = Class.create();
HKOWeatherHandler.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

	handles: function (tableName) {
		//return true;
		return tableName === 'x_snc_duty_travel_duty_travel_req';
	},

    getHKOWeather: function(lang) {
		let hkoHTML = "";
		
		try {
			var inputs = {};
			inputs['lang'] = lang; // String 

			// Start Asynchronously: Uncomment to run in background. Code snippet will not have access to outputs.
			// sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().action('x_snc_duty_travel.get_weather_warning_hko').inBackground().withInputs(inputs).run();
					
			// Execute Synchronously: Run in foreground. Code snippet has access to outputs.
			var result = sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().action('x_snc_duty_travel.get_weather_warning_hko').inForeground().withInputs(inputs).run();
			var outputs = result.getOutputs();

			// Get Outputs:
			// Note: outputs can only be retrieved when executing synchronously.
			var response = outputs['response']; // String
			var status = outputs['status']; // String
			var generalsituation = outputs['generalsituation']; // String

			hkoHTML = generalsituation;
			
		} catch (ex) {
			var message = ex.getMessage();
			gs.error(message);
		}

		return {
			html: hkoHTML,
			updatedOn: new GlideDateTime()
		};
    },

    type: 'HKOWeatherHandler'
};




/**
* A record summary and relevant metadata about it
* @typedef {Object} SummaryReturnObject
* @property {String} html - The HTML content of the summary
* @property {String} updatedOn - When the summary was generated
*/

var DutyTravelSummaryHandler = Class.create();
DutyTravelSummaryHandler.prototype = {
	initialize: function () { },

	/**
	 * Called by the "Get AI Summary for Record" data resource to check whether 
	 * this script include can provide a summary for the specified table.
	 * 
	 * @param {String} tableName The table name to check
	 * @returns {Boolean} Whether this script include handles it or not
	 */
	handles: function (tableName) {
		return tableName === 'x_snc_duty_travel_duty_travel_req';
	},

	/**
	 * Called by the "Get AI Summary for Record" data resource to actually get
	 * the AI summary. Within this method, call out to a custom Now Assist skill
	 * to obtain a summary, and update 
	 * 
	 * @param {String} tableName the table of the record to summarize
	 * @param {String} sysId the sys ID of the record to summarize
	 * @returns {SummaryReturnObject} The record summary
	 */
	getSummaryFor: function (tableName, sysId) {

		let summaryResultHTML = "";

		var request = {
			executionRequests: [{
				payload: {
					duty_travel_request: {
						tableName: tableName,
						sysId: sysId,
						queryString: ''
					}
				},
				capabilityId: 'fa699dec97f22a50fc1cf4ef9153af71',
				meta: {
					skillConfigId: 'cb69156097362a50fc1cf4ef9153af81'
				}
			}],
			mode: 'sync'
		};

		try {
			var output = sn_one_extend.OneExtendUtil.execute(request)['capabilities'][request.executionRequests[0].capabilityId]['response'];
			summaryResultHTML = JSON.parse(output).model_output;
		} catch (e) {
			gs.error(e);
			summaryResultHTML = 'Something went wrong while executing the skill.';
		}

		return {
			html: summaryResultHTML,
			updatedOn: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue()
		};
	},

	type: 'DutyTravelSummaryHandler'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>kb.cheung</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-17 15:02:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>9542cea997722290fc1cf4ef9153afc9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HKOWeatherHandler</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Duty Travel" source="x_snc_duty_travel">76e946e3976e2250fc1cf4ef9153af01</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Duty Travel">76e946e3976e2250fc1cf4ef9153af01</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_9542cea997722290fc1cf4ef9153afc9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>kb.cheung</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-17 16:00:20</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
